pin_recommendation: Keep the current exact pins. HTTP 2.7.0 is compatible but reproduces the same native shutdown errors; older OpenAI 2.x and Anthropic 0.x do not meet framework requirements.
supported: Existing native OpenAIChatModel and AnthropicModel through the Caveman capability or model-only delegate
Agent run_sync, run, run_stream_sync and run_stream with original native history, dependencies, capabilities, and provider options
Ordinary source tool execution, exact Unicode/CRLF recovery and final native answer in both protocols
Anthropic thinking-only pause_turn then recovery through run and run_stream, with unique fresh response IDs, signed thinking and additive per-provider usage
NativeOutput typed results with the native schema and recovery-free transformations
Native stream objects, first content before EOF, cancellation during optimization, native cancellation token, and incomplete usage receipts
Native and wrapped socket EOF before client close or fixture release for context exit, stream.cancel and active task cancellation
Serialized history resume, independent scopes, nested optimization ownership, native retry prompts, and original-content guardrails
Lossiness blocked for fake or filtered recovery, collisions, forced tool choices, extra provider overrides, and structured output

upstream_limits.case: Visible text in Anthropic pause_turn followed by a tool request under Agent.run_stream
upstream_limits.native_and_wrapped_behavior: The tool executes and its result remains in history, but the run returns the earlier visible text after 3 provider requests; no final provider request uses the tool result.
upstream_limits.nonstreaming_behavior: Native and wrapped Agent.run complete after 4 provider requests.

upstream_limits.case: Async-generator shutdown after context exit or stream.cancel
upstream_limits.native_and_wrapped_behavior: Intermittent RuntimeError: generator did not stop after athrow, with httpcore2 safe_async_iterate / HTTP11 / connection-pool frames, on both 2.12.0 and compatible 2.7.0.
upstream_limits.socket_behavior: All 36 cases on each stack reached peer EOF within the 200 ms observation window before fixture release or client close.

uncertified: Providers and model classes outside the explicit adapter gate
